dct_description_sm: Semi-structured research interviews with community members, government officials, and mine workers and executives were conducted to investigate industrial development in contemporary Nunavut, as well as to provide a community record of historical and contemporary mineral development in the Kivalliq Region of Nunavut. The research especially focused on the old North Rankin Nickel Mine (NNRNM) that operated from 1957-1962.
